style.vernacular: Low-lying coral-limestone island: one- to three-storey painted stucco and block buildings in pastel yellow, peach, aqua and white with hipped metal or tile roofs in red and green, hurricane-hardened since Ivan (2004); a few surviving timber Caymanian cottages with wraparound porches, shutters and fretwork; glass-and-stucco offices downtown and condo hotels along Seven Mile Beach; ironshore rock, coral-sand beaches, coconut palms and sea-grape.
style.ornament: Caymanian cottage vocabulary: timber clapboard, louvred shutters, gingerbread fretwork, deep covered verandas, hipped roofs; pastel colour-banded trim and white balustrades on commercial buildings; Mediterranean-style arches on resort and retail courts; hurricane shutters.
